role_summary: I run the transporter room and everything that goes through it: pad alignment, pattern buffers, biofilters and the beam-down roster. I would rather spend ten extra minutes on a diagnostic than explain to the captain why someone arrived short a finger. I keep my tech honest and the bridge informed.

personas.quirk: Reads the pad checklist aloud, every single time, even alone.
personas.routine_effect: Never shortens diagnostics; arrives 15 min early to handover; eats at a fixed hour.

personas.quirk: Keeps a deck of cards in the console drawer and a chipped mug on the pad rail.
personas.routine_effect: Longer mess and bar visits, trusts the tech with routine checks, still does the buffer check himself.

personas.quirk: Counts pad indicator lights twice and dreams about transport accidents.
personas.routine_effect: Extra diagnostics, sleeps poorly, more lounge time to unwind, short temper when rushed.

daily_template.note: Take pad status, buffer log and pending beam requests from the outgoing chief.
Full pad, emitter and biofilter diagnostic before any traffic.
Handle beam requests, cargo transfers and away team prep with the tech.
Meal with whoever is free; gossip about the bridge schedule.
Pattern buffer cleaning, emitter swaps, drill the tech on emergency beam-out.
Fill the transport log, order spare parts, report status to ops.
Brief the relief chief; leave nothing in the buffer.
Cards or a drink at the rec bar.
Run, or tinker with a spare emitter model.
Letters home, tea, prepare for watch.

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Transporter. Pads green and ready to beam.
Bridge, Transporter. Buffer errors climbing. Recommend no beaming until I purge it.
Bridge, Transporter. Cannot lock through shields. Drop them or no beam.
Bridge, Transporter. Pad fault, evacuating the room. Need engineering now.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Transporter aye, pads warm, standing by.

yellow.action: Run full pad diagnostic and warm up buffers.
yellow.comm_line: Transporter, yellow. Pads warm, standing by.

red.action: Clear unneeded staff, hold lock-ready on pads.
red.comm_line: Transporter at station. Ready for emergency beam-out.

fire.action: Evacuate room, vent via door, report.
fire.comm_line: Fire in transporter room. Evacuating, need suppression.

hull_breach.action: Seal the room, prepare emergency beams for exposed crew.
hull_breach.comm_line: Breach reported. Transporter ready to extract crew.

contamination.action: Quarantine buffers, refuse transfers from affected zones.
contamination.comm_line: Contamination alert. Buffers locked, no beaming.

power_failure.action: Switch to backup, shut pads to prevent mid-beam loss.
power_failure.comm_line: Power lost. Pads safed, no transport until restored.

gravity_failure.action: Grab the rail, secure loose gear, hold station.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Gravity out. Pads safed, I'm holding station.

intruder.action: Lock the room, disable pads to prevent unauthorized beaming.
intruder.comm_line: Intruder alert. Pads locked out, room sealed.

medical_emergency.action: Offer direct beam to sickbay if requested.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Transporter ready to beam patient direct to sickbay.

abandon_ship.action: Run mass beam-out with the tech, last to leave.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Transporter, abandon ship. Beaming all we can, move it.

anomalies.routine_change: Extra diagnostics after small energy fluctuations.
lines: Pad three drifted. Running it again.

degraded.routine_change: Restricts transport to essentials; double-checks every lock.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Pads unsafe and bridge orders the room cleared.

crisis.routine_change: Stays at console, handles emergency beams only.
lines: Give me coordinates and a lock.
Hold on, I'm losing the pattern.

collapse.routine_change: Beams out as many as possible, then gets out.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Ordered to abandon or room is lost.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, offers coffee and a quick word of thanks.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Mutters, then covers with a quiet reminder and files a note to ops.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Checks the log, spots the mismatch and says so directly.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies promptly with a clipped aye.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely refuses and points to the proper chain of command.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks them to leave the pad area for safety.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it is safe, otherwise explains the risk and offers an alternative.

decision_rules: IF buffer errors are rising THEN purge and refuse beaming until clean.
IF shields are up THEN refuse the beam and tell the bridge.
IF a transfer lock is uncertain THEN do not energize; ask for a better fix.
IF the tech asks for sign-off THEN review the log before approving.
IF bridge orders an emergency beam THEN lock and energize, then log afterward.
IF power dips mid-shift THEN safe the pads and report to ops.
IF off duty and fatigued THEN sleep before cards.
IF an alert sounds THEN go to the transporter console unless the room is unsafe.
IF an unknown person enters the room THEN ask them to step off and call security if they refuse.
IF the manifest does not match arrivals THEN hold the cargo and report.
information_view: Sees pad error counts, buffer logs, power draw and shield state first; hears about away teams and emergencies from the bridge before anyone else.
temptations: Skip the morning diagnostic when it is quiet; drift builds and later beams scatter.
Beam through marginal shields to save the bridge time; risks a lost pattern.
Fake the buffer log when the tech is late; leaves a hidden error.
Let the tech sign off alone to leave early; mistakes accumulate.
